levels.surface: أبي بكر بن أبي الجهم بن صخير العدوي

notes: «قالا حدثنا وكيع» makes the pair one level of co-transmitters (rule 2)
«قال سمعت فاطمة بنت قيس» links Abu Bakr b. Abi al-Jahm to Fatima, who relays the Prophet's words: she is the last link
the Prophet's sayings and the proposal scene are the matn, not links
